thread:
anya: Heads-up: customers in eu-central reporting 500s and huge tail latency on Dedicated pools since ~08:10 UTC. Started after autoscaler retries spiked.
mike: Seeing same in dashboards — placement failures + 429s from placement API. Can you paste the error traces?
anya: Paste from the deploy bot logs: ```placement: alloc failed: region=eu-central reason=GPUSupplyShortage, backoff: 15s, retry_count: 6
request_id=pl-9a3f...
```
katie: Some tenants got automatically failed over to eu-west which then started hitting auth 401s intermittently. Suspect token cache invalidation during cross-regional routing.
luis: Also noticed a noisy-tenant on eu-central using >3x expected memory, triggering eviction/compact loops on those hosts. Putting link to pod logs: `https://logs.redwood/dedicated/eu-central/noj-223`
ops-oncall: Rolling up: symptoms = placement 500/429, high tail latency for in-flight requests, some customer 401s after failover, and billing anomalies (double charging) reported by billing-bot.
billing-bot: Alert: several invoices flagged — rerouted requests were billed under fallback region (eu-west) and also recorded as failed in eu-central -> duplicate charge counter. Customers: acct-847, acct-199.
mike: Oof. So two issues: capacity shortfall in eu-central and stateful failover causing token/session inconsistencies that lead to 401 + duplicate billing events.
anya: Repro steps I ran: 1) Create Dedicated reservation in eu-central. 2) Simulate noise by spawning stress jobs on noisy-tenant. 3) Hit model endpoint with burst traffic. Result: allocation fails, requests queued, autoscaler retries, then router sends to eu-west; on return some auth checks fail because oauth session key stored in region-local session cache.
luis: Commands I used to reproduce the allocator logs: ```curl -s -X POST https://allocator.internal/alloc -d '{"region":"eu-central","gpus":4,"tenant":"acct-847"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <test-token>'``` response: `{"error":"GPUSupplyShortage","code":503}`
katie: Quick mitigation suggestions?
ops-oncall: Short term: 1) Re-enable sticky-region routing for existing sessions so we don't cross-region flip mid-request. 2) Manually bump reserve-pool for eu-central from spare-capacity (if any). 3) Suspend noisy-tenant’s autoscale rules.
anya: I pushed a config change to router to prefer origin-region for 30s for in-flight sessions. Deploy bot shows successful rollout to edge nodes.
sre-bot: deploy:router-config v2.14 -> success across eu nodes (rollout-id: r-4452)
mike: Thanks. For the token problem we should rapidly add fallback check: if remote auth fails due to cache miss, fallback to central auth with verification, instead of immediate 401.
luis: Filing a follow-up issue for session-store replication: we currently only replicate session keys every 10m; need near-real-time for failover. Filing: https://issues.redwood/RED-9082
katie: Billing: can we issue pro-rated credits for affected customers while we triage? billing-bot, can you create credits for acct-847 & acct-199 and mark invoices as under review?
billing-bot: Created credit tickets CT-1229, CT-1230. Marked invoices as pending-review.
ops-oncall: Longer term actions: - capacity planning call with infra to evaluate GPU supply in eu-central + create cross-region warm pools; - autoscaler backoff logic review to avoid retry storms; - noisy-tenant quota enforcement improvements.
mike: Assigning owners: infra-capacity (luis), autoscaler (anya), routing/auth (katie), billing (mike). Can we target mitigation ship by EOD?
anya: I have a partial fix for autoscaler backoff (throttle jitter + early abort) in a branch, will open PR and try to get it to canary by 15:30 UTC.
luis: I'll check physical inventory and coordinate with cloud provider for extra GPU rentals. If we can get +20 GPUs in eu-central within 6 hours that should remove immediate backpressure.
katie: I'll prototype central auth fallback path today. If we can't get TTL replication faster, fallback auth will avoid 401s on failover.
mike: Customer comms: SRE to draft message for impacted customers: explain root cause (regional GPU supply + noisy tenant), mitigation steps, credits. I'll coordinate.
ops-oncall: Temporary workarounds applied: sticky-region routing enabled; noisy-tenant scaled down via emergency quota, allocate queue draining. Metrics show 70% reduction in placement failures.
anya: Update: placement failures dropped from 18/min to 5/min after sticky routing. Some queued requests still draining; tail latency improving.
luis: Provider update: can provision 12 GPUs in 4h, 28 GPUs in 18h. I'm requesting 12 now.
mike: OK. Keep this thread updated. After we stable, we'll run a post-incident with repro, timeline, and follow-ups (RED-9082, RED-9083 autoscaler, RED-9084 billing dedupe).
katie: Noted. Also adding test case to chaos suite to simulate region failover + auth cache miss.
billing-bot: Billing credit CT-1229/CT-1230 scheduled for next cycle. Logged customer outreach tickets.
anya: Final status (09:07 UTC): immediate mitigations holding, need infra capacity increase & session-store work for full fix. Will update when GPUs confirmed.
mike: Thanks team. Closing active pager. Follow-up meeting in 1h to triage next actions. :thumbsup:
